environment.description: Application deployed on ECS Fargate behind an ALB. The ALB has an AWS WAFv2 WebACL attached with the following configuration: (1) Rule group 'aws-waf-custom-sqli-body-qs' with priority 1 that applies AWSManagedRulesCommonRuleSet with SizeRestriction_QUERYSTRING rule in COUNT mode only, (2) A custom rate-limiting rule at priority 2 limiting to 100 requests per 5 minutes per IP, and (3) Rule group reference at priority 0 to AWSManagedRulesSQLiRuleSet with override action NONE (meaning individual rule actions within the managed group apply — all SQLi rules are in BLOCK mode by default). The WebACL default action is ALLOW. Additionally, the ALB target group has a custom attribute setting `routing.http.drop_invalid_header_fields.enabled=true`. The ECS task role has no permissions beyond ECR pull and CloudWatch Logs.

rules.name: AWS-AWSManagedRulesSQLiRuleSet
rules.note: Individual rule actions apply (default BLOCK for all SQLi detection rules)
